rate_invalid.fail: TAX-001: The tax rate of {label} is not usable: {detail}.
rate_invalid.suggestion: Enter a rate between 0 and 100, or pick a tax code that is on file for the project country on the pricing date.

taxable_without_rate.fail: TAX-002: {label} is marked taxable but has neither a tax rate nor a tax code.
taxable_without_rate.suggestion: Enter the rate, pick a tax code, or change the status to exempt or out of scope.

exempt_with_rate.fail: TAX-003: {label} is exempt but carries a tax rate of {rate} %, which is ignored.
exempt_with_rate.suggestion: Clear the rate or change the status to taxable.

inclusive_without_rate.fail: TAX-004: The price of {label} includes tax, but no rate is known to take it out.
inclusive_without_rate.suggestion: Enter the rate or a tax code, or untick that the price includes tax.

master_price_drift.fail: TAX-005: {label} is priced at {unit_cost}, the master price is {master}.
master_price_drift.suggestion: Run the tax recalculation to take the master price, or approve the assembly to keep its price.

rate_outside_validity.fail: TAX-006: Tax code {code} of {label} has no rate in force on {date}.
rate_outside_validity.suggestion: Pick the pricing date the rate applies to, or enter the rate by hand.
